summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 3-tier PricingTiers section on the minimal landing page (/). Verified DOM structure, ordering, content, feature counts, badges, trust row, journey strip, payment footer, and CTA routing for both unauthenticated and authenticated (testpremium-mar@elitescout.com) flows on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x812). 15/15 test cases passed.
tests_executed: PASS: hero-minimal, pricing-tiers, faq-minimal all present and in correct DOM order (hero → pricing → faq)
PASS: pricing-card-free / pricing-card-premium / pricing-card-vip all rendered
PASS: pricing-cta-free / pricing-cta-premium / pricing-cta-vip all present and enabled
PASS: 'MOST POPULAR' badge on Premium card and 'BEST VALUE' badge on VIP card
PASS: Feature counts exact — Free 11 (4 checked + 7 unchecked), Premium 10 (7 checked + 3 unchecked), VIP 7 (all 7 checked)
PASS: pricing-trust-row visible with 4 columns (Trusted, Connected, Data-driven, Secure)
PASS: pricing-journey-strip visible — heading 'Your journey · Our mission' + pricing-journey-cta clickable
PASS: pricing-payment-footer visible with 'No credit card required to start' + Apple Pay + Google Pay + Card
PASS (mobile 375x812): cards stack vertically (single column, all x=24), CTA heights 52/48/48px (all ≥44px), free CTA tappable and navigates
PASS (regression): FAQ accordion toggle clickable, footer present, login flow works
critical_code_review_comments: PricingTiers.jsx is ~464 lines and self-contained — manageable, no split needed yet
useAuth + useNavigate routing logic is clean and handles both auth states
The /signup?plan=<tier> query param is a placeholder — when subscription backend is built, SignUp page (and /upload) should read this param and pre-select the plan / route to checkout
test_credentials: testpremium-mar@elitescout.com / Premium@2026! used for logged-in routing test
context_for_next_testing_agent: PricingTiers section is fully verified on /. CTA behavior: anonymous → /signup?plan=<tier>; logged-in → /upload?plan=<tier> (Free CTA → /upload without query). No backend changes. /signup currently does not consume the plan query param — that wiring belongs to a future iteration when subscription checkout is built.
